{{Top|leg}}
A '''gyro-grappler''' was a device designed to aid in climbing walls or [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]]. Essentially a [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]] equipped with [[microthruster]]s, the gyro-grappler allowed for a user to throw a grappling hook normally by hand, and then have the near-silent [[Engine/Legends|thrusters]] boost the hook and any attached cable to a target up to a distance of several hundred [[Meter/Legends|meters]].
